children: ALBEMARLE, N.C., Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On October 20, 2026, the Board of Directors of Uwharrie Capital Corp (OTCQX: UWHR) declared a 3% common stock dividend, payable on November 23, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 5, 2026.

The stock dividend will be issued electronically in book-entry form. No stock certificates will be issued. Shareholders will receive a statement reflecting the additional shares credited to their accounts. For shares held in brokerage accounts, the dividend shares will be credited directly to the applicable brokerage account.

Only whole shares will be issued. Shareholders who would otherwise be entitled to receive a fractional share will instead receive cash in lieu of the fractional share. Such cash payments may be made by check or electronic deposit, as applicable.

Uwharrie Capital Corp offers a full range of financial solutions through its subsidiaries: Uwharrie Bank and Uwharrie Investment Advisors. Additional information on Uwharrie Capital Corp may be found at
